sloka: स च कामपराधीनः पतिस्तासां महाबलः ।सीतासक्तमना मन्दो मन्दाञ्चितगतिर्बभौ ।। ५-१८-१९।।
transliteration: sa ca kāmaparādhīnaḥ patistāsāṁ mahābalaḥ ।sītāsaktamanā mando mandāñcitagatirbabhau ।। 5-18-19।।

translations.english: Their husband, powerful Ravana under the control of passion looking dull, absorbed in the thoughts of Sita walked slowly as though counting his steps.
